b0af82f8-ae06-44bb-8969-772e7e068bc4.description: Map showing the flows of people, goods, information or ideas between places.

9a44fa50-1011-4fe7-9b81-7139f7395fad.title: fronts
9a44fa50-1011-4fe7-9b81-7139f7395fad.description: A boundary between 2 air masses of different temperatures and humidity.

0f40821d-cab7-405f-ba4d-affb0232c08e.title: geographic information system (GIS)
0f40821d-cab7-405f-ba4d-affb0232c08e.description: Technology for capturing, storing, analysing and presenting geographic data. It is used to understand spatial relationships and patterns.

ae410ae3-fc00-43fd-8353-df74bbc37ba0.title: geomorphic hazard
ae410ae3-fc00-43fd-8353-df74bbc37ba0.description: A hazard event originating in the lithosphere, e.g. volcanic eruptions, earthquakes, tsunamis and mass movement (landslides or avalanches).

c42b3f48-0034-4de6-b0e8-cc36b4b6abc4.title: global positioning systems (GPS)
c42b3f48-0034-4de6-b0e8-cc36b4b6abc4.description: Navigation systems that provide location and time information when there is a line of sight to GPS satellites.

3cd8646e-5608-4a22-a10f-b33bfa0d747c.title: graduated or proportional symbol maps
3cd8646e-5608-4a22-a10f-b33bfa0d747c.description: A map where symbols vary in size according to the value they represent.

2765606a-af01-494d-8ed7-702038a1a73c.title: hydrological hazard
2765606a-af01-494d-8ed7-702038a1a73c.description: A hazard event originating in the hydrosphere, e.g. floods and droughts.

f0d68442-fdbb-4a1f-bfb0-76053d065fb3.title: hydrological processes
f0d68442-fdbb-4a1f-bfb0-76053d065fb3.description: The movement of water in the Earth’s system that shapes and influences environments.

dd614462-9dc6-4700-bcac-6c23c542bda0.title: internal migration
dd614462-9dc6-4700-bcac-6c23c542bda0.description: The movement of people living in one defined area to another within the same country.

05b53d0e-a6ad-4b0a-8ea9-dff65ef479f7.title: international migration
05b53d0e-a6ad-4b0a-8ea9-dff65ef479f7.description: The voluntary or forced movement of people between countries.

ca636429-f0a9-4440-b8fb-1b985006f5ba.title: isoline maps
ca636429-f0a9-4440-b8fb-1b985006f5ba.description: A thematic map which has lines joining places that have the same value of any selected element, e.g. rainfall, temperature or ocean depth.

a6fb49c3-b082-406e-bfaf-ab49a5783973.title: land use maps
a6fb49c3-b082-406e-bfaf-ab49a5783973.description: A map showing how land is used, e.g. for infrastructure, settlements or agriculture.

90243e0e-a535-4fe0-a1f3-4c3f7d225214.title: landforms
90243e0e-a535-4fe0-a1f3-4c3f7d225214.description: The individual surface features of the Earth as identified by their shape.

4eeb718c-1cb3-4b3e-96c8-29a07f4ae4a8.title: landscapes
4eeb718c-1cb3-4b3e-96c8-29a07f4ae4a8.description: An area that has evolved over time, created by a combination of geological, geomorphological, biological and cultural layers.

26e0a60b-3c28-4629-8998-dba7b2ccd7eb.title: large-scale maps
26e0a60b-3c28-4629-8998-dba7b2ccd7eb.description: A map that covers a small area with a comprehensive amount of detail.

ad27d82d-0b44-44fb-972d-c1300f28a959.title: latitude and longitude
ad27d82d-0b44-44fb-972d-c1300f28a959.description: Lines on a map used to find broad locations in degrees or precise locations in degrees and minutes, north/south of the equator and east/west of the Greenwich meridian.

e9832950-bd37-477f-a834-aab0674f232a.title: line drawings
e9832950-bd37-477f-a834-aab0674f232a.description: A type of black-and-white illustration that uses lines to represent the main features of a geographical area without detailed shading or colour.

af8216af-5689-44ae-b251-dc3f1ba051fb.title: linear scale
af8216af-5689-44ae-b251-dc3f1ba051fb.description: A line on a map showing the relationship between distances on a map and distances in the real world.

889dd81e-e9bf-44fa-ad8a-8ce60065256d.title: local relief
889dd81e-e9bf-44fa-ad8a-8ce60065256d.description: The difference in altitude between the highest and lowest points in a small geographical area.

d7be92cd-3410-4e4b-8f52-4a25a0d9e10c.title: photo sketches
d7be92cd-3410-4e4b-8f52-4a25a0d9e10c.description: A type of sketch based on a photograph used to highlight key features or elements of the landscape or area of study.

c981db70-2d51-4142-9fb2-4d25c1beba98.title: photographs
c981db70-2d51-4142-9fb2-4d25c1beba98.description: Photographs taken from different locations, e.g. from earth, in the air or from space or from different angles.

9960e613-1653-4e55-bf4b-7106ea63b923.title: physical features (on a map)
9960e613-1653-4e55-bf4b-7106ea63b923.description: Physical or natural features located in an environment.

6c69d974-b744-4fb4-8310-1829acde830c.title: physical maps
6c69d974-b744-4fb4-8310-1829acde830c.description: A map that displays natural features of the Earth’s surface.

438d8f4c-175b-4843-a549-c6e1ebf176bb.title: political maps
438d8f4c-175b-4843-a549-c6e1ebf176bb.description: A map displaying the boundaries of countries, states and cities, and which highlights political divisions.

447ca9b0-4b33-4d91-8862-8212afe12d16.title: population profiles
447ca9b0-4b33-4d91-8862-8212afe12d16.description: A graph showing the age and gender composition of a population.

7602da25-6fe1-47a7-bdc3-42878801884c.title: précis maps
7602da25-6fe1-47a7-bdc3-42878801884c.description: A simple sketch map, drawn from a topographic map or photograph, showing the key patterns and features of an area by omitting minor details.

c691d6de-5cdf-470f-834c-e4b3cb9f4ec9.title: pressure patterns
c691d6de-5cdf-470f-834c-e4b3cb9f4ec9.description: The distribution and movement of high-pressure and low-pressure systems on a weather map.

28d3c0e3-e129-47bc-877c-458ca702b52c.title: productivity
28d3c0e3-e129-47bc-877c-458ca702b52c.description: The amount of biomass or living plant material produced through photosynthesis that influences ecosystems and food chain dynamics.

aa65e22d-ec77-4749-9688-98201c867987.title: range of scales
aa65e22d-ec77-4749-9688-98201c867987.description: Frames of reference for viewing and analysing the world spatially at a local, national, regional or global scale.

02a19779-d735-4cd3-a2bc-6a5d43adb950.title: relief maps
02a19779-d735-4cd3-a2bc-6a5d43adb950.description: A 3-dimensional map showing the shape of the land and distinctive landforms (terrain) or a 2-dimensional map representing 3D terrain.

1b23b767-dd5c-406b-a7fe-d8fd4b2ae0ea.title: remote sensing data
1b23b767-dd5c-406b-a7fe-d8fd4b2ae0ea.description: Information collected from satellites or aircraft about Earth’s geographical features from a distance.

5821ffe7-9bd9-4910-b8dc-b2c0b684148a.title: scatter plot
5821ffe7-9bd9-4910-b8dc-b2c0b684148a.description: A graph of 2 variables where individual data points are plotted on a horizontal and vertical axis. Scatter plots are used to observe relationships between variables.

dd7d2500-1200-490f-b7e8-77c73e4ad2f9.title: sector graphs
dd7d2500-1200-490f-b7e8-77c73e4ad2f9.description: A graph that divides a circle into segments or sectors, each representing a portion of a whole.

7c906bba-eb1d-4ebd-9d13-d01aa31ab91c.title: sketch maps
7c906bba-eb1d-4ebd-9d13-d01aa31ab91c.description: A simplified map or illustration outlining the main geographical features of an area.

4730a122-3b85-4634-9971-6f3ec29db720.title: small-scale maps
4730a122-3b85-4634-9971-6f3ec29db720.description: A map that covers a large area with limited amount of detail.

fd80ab28-033d-4177-a0e4-8a15ae7286c1.title: spatial inequality
fd80ab28-033d-4177-a0e4-8a15ae7286c1.description: The uneven distribution of resources, opportunities or conditions across different areas.

4f77d197-d2ab-413b-91e9-a6bab4ba643e.title: spatial patterns
4f77d197-d2ab-413b-91e9-a6bab4ba643e.description: The positioning or organisation of phenomena or features in a geographic space.

6dd32be0-d299-4aa7-8d2c-47fa0a2ff015.title: spatial variation
6dd32be0-d299-4aa7-8d2c-47fa0a2ff015.description: The difference or variation in natural and human-made features over an area of the Earth’s surface.

f273456e-5c95-42d5-b9dc-bf4f7272c47c.title: special-purpose maps
f273456e-5c95-42d5-b9dc-bf4f7272c47c.description: A map designed to be used for a particular purpose or by a group of users.

6c973313-62ca-444e-89db-f5c73527170b.title: spot heights
6c973313-62ca-444e-89db-f5c73527170b.description: A specific point most commonly found on a topographic map that indicates the exact elevation or altitude above sea level.

0dcd7176-bbfa-413b-b8dc-52090ee4ea0f.title: tactile graphics and models
0dcd7176-bbfa-413b-b8dc-52090ee4ea0f.description: Diagrams and 3D representations produced with raised lines, shapes and textured surfaces that can be explored visually and/or tactually.

32f430db-8004-47bb-9f4b-a6b959996fa5.title: thematic maps
32f430db-8004-47bb-9f4b-a6b959996fa5.description: Maps that feature one theme or topic and that use colour, shading, dots, symbols or lines joining places of equal value, e.g. a choropleth map or isoline map.

a6be6ab7-8fa0-4b81-8b9f-8f24ae54ce0f.title: topographic maps
a6be6ab7-8fa0-4b81-8b9f-8f24ae54ce0f.description: A detailed, large-scale map of part of the Earth’s surface which illustrates the shape of the land and selected natural and human features.

ea5aaf26-6df9-498e-8750-a7a9e8356d20.title: trade flows
ea5aaf26-6df9-498e-8750-a7a9e8356d20.description: The movement of goods, services or capital between regions or countries.

a696d392-b70e-4ff7-92c1-78a92159db51.title: transect
a696d392-b70e-4ff7-92c1-78a92159db51.description: A straight line drawn on a map between 2 points, used to represent changes in elevation, landforms and other geographical features along the path.

5ae9bbda-a2da-4446-ae32-bdbe0bff8862.title: urban planning
5ae9bbda-a2da-4446-ae32-bdbe0bff8862.description: Designing and organising the layout of cities and towns.

a29b239c-c4d1-4bed-a6e6-737bc529eb85.title: virtual or digital map
a29b239c-c4d1-4bed-a6e6-737bc529eb85.description: Maps that are interactive and can include zooming, panning, layering and search functionality.

76f57f2e-d1e8-4cda-adf1-fca030d65bea.title: water resources
76f57f2e-d1e8-4cda-adf1-fca030d65bea.description: A natural resource existing in different forms, irregularly distributed and useful to people and their activities.

5eb4e9d6-6d9e-416f-ab37-6f8429b8990e.title: water scarcity
5eb4e9d6-6d9e-416f-ab37-6f8429b8990e.description: Lack of sufficient available water resources to meet the demand due to water shortage (physical), lack of money to use an adequate water source (economic) or unequal distribution of water resources.

1f18ae39-ba31-4e22-8eca-929d7c413ae5.title: weather map or synoptic chart
1f18ae39-ba31-4e22-8eca-929d7c413ae5.description: A map showing atmospheric conditions at the Earth’s surface at a point in time.

8f32ef26-d0d6-4c97-ae81-efb50e58aaa6.title: weathering
8f32ef26-d0d6-4c97-ae81-efb50e58aaa6.description: The breaking down of rock and surface materials that have been exposed to the natural processes of weather, chemical reactions, and actions of plants and animals.

0349a01e-3912-4088-b0f1-037ce0485740.title: agricultural production
0349a01e-3912-4088-b0f1-037ce0485740.description: The use of land for cultivating crops and raising livestock to produce food, fibres and industrial materials.

2b48410b-8c61-462e-9857-79327a89d380.title: altitude
2b48410b-8c61-462e-9857-79327a89d380.description: Height of a feature above sea level.

a85f482c-d457-4494-9684-2d1c50eafd74.title: atmospheric hazard
a85f482c-d457-4494-9684-2d1c50eafd74.description: A hazard event, originating in the atmosphere, e.g. a storm or tropical cyclone.

6ad22e83-54cd-4a70-8e13-6863284f8167.title: bearing
6ad22e83-54cd-4a70-8e13-6863284f8167.description: A direction from one point on the Earth’s surface to another, measured in degrees from 0 to 360.

af3a6356-1639-41d6-95e1-0257e3106934.title: biomes
af3a6356-1639-41d6-95e1-0257e3106934.description: A major terrestrial region defined by its climate, vegetation and animal life.

f97f0f5f-8171-4e44-b0ea-0311fbc63404.title: biophysical processes
f97f0f5f-8171-4e44-b0ea-0311fbc63404.description: The atmospheric, biological, chemical and physical processes that take place in the lithosphere, hydrosphere, atmosphere and biosphere, e.g. erosion, deposition, soil formation, nutrient cycling.

154b089a-fc9a-4a13-9e13-0ea2e8b254ab.title: choropleth maps
154b089a-fc9a-4a13-9e13-0ea2e8b254ab.description: A thematic map with shadings to provide quantitative information about different areas or regions.

6a594d30-d718-497d-912c-6fed5d8cb29d.title: climate graphs
6a594d30-d718-497d-912c-6fed5d8cb29d.description: A graph showing average monthly temperature and precipitation for a location.

967d2116-395e-4e1c-87fd-4282562b34a6.title: features
967d2116-395e-4e1c-87fd-4282562b34a6.description: The tangible elements of a place or environment.

bd6cbd1d-6ea1-419a-af1b-5ff0dd72f9b2.title: erosion
bd6cbd1d-6ea1-419a-af1b-5ff0dd72f9b2.description: The process by which soil, rocks and other surface materials are carried away, by the actions of water, wind or ice.

6cc7566d-b171-4b3d-8f25-31edf949d6b1.title: bubble charts
6cc7566d-b171-4b3d-8f25-31edf949d6b1.description: Type of graph that displays data points as bubbles on a 2-dimensional axis. The size, colour and position of a bubble can represent different variables.

dd8dc1fe-5f68-497e-bcb0-f3dccd6c0d22.title: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples' Knowledge systems
dd8dc1fe-5f68-497e-bcb0-f3dccd6c0d22.description: The ways of Knowing, Being and Doing developed by Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples. These Cultural Knowledge systems are closely connected to Country, Place, Culture and Community.

f0c6c914-f2e1-4720-bc63-93fb135bf090.title: biodiversity hotspots
f0c6c914-f2e1-4720-bc63-93fb135bf090.description: Areas rich in different species that are under threat.

3d0522d2-9c67-4848-826c-9aa0701e282d.title: ecological
3d0522d2-9c67-4848-826c-9aa0701e282d.description: Relating to the interactions between living organisms and their environment, including how species depend on and affect one another within ecosystems.

26dc0066-2e18-4d4f-b4d4-1dfb488dd833.title: environmental stewardship
26dc0066-2e18-4d4f-b4d4-1dfb488dd833.description: Caring for the environment in a responsible and respectful way so that it remains healthy for future generations. In Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Cultures, environmental stewardship is guided by Cultural connections to Country and Place, where caring for the environment also means caring for Community.

e53b4c52-8b07-4165-94fa-fcf992e101ee.title: extreme environmental events
e53b4c52-8b07-4165-94fa-fcf992e101ee.description: Hazardous and often unpredictable occurrences, such as floods, bushfire or cyclones, that can cause major environmental, social and economic impacts.

2fb13146-93c7-43da-9ea3-97ed9d8b57c6.title: extreme environments
2fb13146-93c7-43da-9ea3-97ed9d8b57c6.description: A specific location with severe natural conditions that challenge survival, often marked by extreme climate, limited resources or chemically intense settings.

88a6ed1c-855f-49c3-a436-91be20282d81.title: geophysical
88a6ed1c-855f-49c3-a436-91be20282d81.description: Relating to the Earth’s processes and forces, including those occurring on and beneath its surface.

cc7fed60-babf-422a-b7ba-5512c31ba23c.title: geothermal zones
cc7fed60-babf-422a-b7ba-5512c31ba23c.description: Areas on Earth’s surface, or underground where heat from the Earth’s interior rises to the surface, often characterised by volcanic activity, hot springs or geysers.

81014279-c9b5-4e01-8513-4e5fc211b190.title: global air circulation
81014279-c9b5-4e01-8513-4e5fc211b190.description: The large-scale movement of air that redistributes heat and moisture around the Earth, forming wind belts, pressure zones and influencing climate patterns.

897683dd-4102-4a32-bdb9-f6143b8af903.title: insolation
897683dd-4102-4a32-bdb9-f6143b8af903.description: The amount of solar energy reaching the Earth over a specific period, influenced by the planet’s tilt, orbit and atmospheric scattering and absorption.

7960348e-baa6-4bb2-88f5-fcc4954eb816.title: maritime boundaries
7960348e-baa6-4bb2-88f5-fcc4954eb816.description: Divisions of maritime space where different countries have rights to use and control the water, seabed and natural resources.

eb953d2d-e3ff-4b52-974c-25582c35ca71.title: maritime choke points
eb953d2d-e3ff-4b52-974c-25582c35ca71.description: A narrow maritime passage critical for global shipping and trade where congestion or disruption can significantly affect transport routes and security.

6c81cd18-ec3c-4208-82f3-39c4d94ec566.title: natural disaster
6c81cd18-ec3c-4208-82f3-39c4d94ec566.description: When a natural hazard results in extensive damage to people, places and environments.

fd6114f9-ce25-4cf4-9642-c8d400340818.title: navigational rights
fd6114f9-ce25-4cf4-9642-c8d400340818.description: Legal freedoms under international law that allow ships to pass through oceans, such as territorial seas, straits and exclusive economic zones.

c5b1f684-8333-42d0-b1e7-fdd4265def9c.title: pressure systems
c5b1f684-8333-42d0-b1e7-fdd4265def9c.description: Large-scale patterns of high or low atmospheric pressure that influence wind, rainfall and weather conditions over regions.

407c9810-bc24-415d-be60-88748ebb3aac.title: primary production
407c9810-bc24-415d-be60-88748ebb3aac.description: The harvesting or extraction of natural resources from the environment to produce raw materials in industries such as agriculture, mining, fishing and forestry.

2258b824-c123-4a94-a05b-552cb158a1ca.title: sovereignty
2258b824-c123-4a94-a05b-552cb158a1ca.description: The authority of a state, community or political unit to govern itself and exercise control over its territory, population, resources and internal affairs without external interference.

d83d4632-8dd7-4121-9920-5c945e52c21d.title: spatial scale
d83d4632-8dd7-4121-9920-5c945e52c21d.description: The size and extent of a geographical space, ranging from local to global scales.

0127fe61-dc1f-49ba-a190-e70c0d9af564.title: temporal scale
0127fe61-dc1f-49ba-a190-e70c0d9af564.description: The timeframe over which a geographical process, pattern or event occurs ranging from short-term to long-term.

35d63444-e34f-42bd-a924-2f9e4800dd81.title: topography
35d63444-e34f-42bd-a924-2f9e4800dd81.description: The relief and configuration of a landscape, including its natural and man-made features.

4efe0a6f-d65b-420c-8219-3b91c85014d1.title: vegetation zones
4efe0a6f-d65b-420c-8219-3b91c85014d1.description: Large areas of land classified by dominant plant types and climate conditions.

09710c22-883a-4102-823f-79b149d3cd88.title: Oral histories
09710c22-883a-4102-823f-79b149d3cd88.description:
An account of the past shared through Oral traditions such as song and story.

See Oral traditions

2494f7a8-0559-4d78-85ce-33f0b11bef72.title: nation-state
2494f7a8-0559-4d78-85ce-33f0b11bef72.description: A country with defined borders, a recognised government and common nationality.

a991fe2b-187d-41cd-b900-693e12bedecf.title: weather
a991fe2b-187d-41cd-b900-693e12bedecf.description: The state of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, with respect to wind, precipitation, temperature, cloud cover, humidity and air pressure.

2f5a579d-6ae7-4ea8-941a-b5011099610f.title: change
2f5a579d-6ae7-4ea8-941a-b5011099610f.description: The concept of change involves both time and space. Places, environments and geographical phenomena can often be best understood by investigating how they have developed over time periods ranging from a few years to thousands of years. This is important in helping students to understand what is happening around them and to see their world as dynamic.

1a60cc7d-20a4-4238-a787-98dd5af4e99e.title: deforestation
1a60cc7d-20a4-4238-a787-98dd5af4e99e.description: The clearing of trees from land to allow for other uses.

a86d3e51-29eb-4ec8-8d98-2534a7794b60.title: economic activity
a86d3e51-29eb-4ec8-8d98-2534a7794b60.description: The production, distribution or consumption of goods or services at all levels of society.

65ed3ffe-34b6-4b5d-b02c-3d54577e124f.title: global distribution
65ed3ffe-34b6-4b5d-b02c-3d54577e124f.description: The spatial distribution of geographical phenomena throughout the world, e.g. population, megacities and earthquake hazards.

05cf113b-6485-40d8-b41a-dffccf14f520.title: hazards
05cf113b-6485-40d8-b41a-dffccf14f520.description: When the forces of nature combine to become destructive and have potential to damage the environment and endanger communities.

de9b1d98-a72b-4c97-869d-a7c37cab5135.title: interconnection
de9b1d98-a72b-4c97-869d-a7c37cab5135.description: The concept of interconnection emphasises that no object of geographical study can be viewed in isolation. It is about the ways that geographical phenomena are connected to each other through environmental processes, the movement of people, flows of trade and investment, the purchase of goods and services, cultural influences, the exchange of ideas and information, political power and international agreements. Interconnections can be complex, reciprocal or interdependent, and have a strong influence on the characteristics of places. An understanding of the significance of interconnection leads to holistic thinking and helps students to see the various aspects of Geography as connected rather than separate bodies of knowledge.

53e9d09c-19d2-447b-822f-40f2a5c1ff69.title: adaptation
53e9d09c-19d2-447b-822f-40f2a5c1ff69.description: An alteration in the structure or function of living things which enables them to survive, multiply and improve their chances at survival in a changed environment.

e018d3e5-476a-4a70-8a46-b1a1c2180389.title: conservation
e018d3e5-476a-4a70-8a46-b1a1c2180389.description: The management and preservation of the natural environment and resources to ensure they are not destroyed in the process of development. The preservation of areas which are culturally or scientifically significant in their natural state.

963e0265-59fb-4e4b-b808-b2566da95a9d.title: demography
963e0265-59fb-4e4b-b808-b2566da95a9d.description: The science of vital and social statistics such as the births, deaths, diseases, and/or marriages of human populations. It is the range of different groups existing in a particular population, as distinguished by factors such as age, ethnicity, social background and other statistics.

f70ed5cf-8a33-4db4-8d27-3c0f416bf974.title: infrastructure
f70ed5cf-8a33-4db4-8d27-3c0f416bf974.description: The built environment which includes buildings and transport, as well as electricity, gas, water and sanitation connections.

ac506608-2f0f-4d40-8bf1-81a975568a73.title: precipitation
ac506608-2f0f-4d40-8bf1-81a975568a73.description: Forms of water that fall from the atmosphere to the Earth’s surface, e.g. rain, hail, snow, sleet.

53df87e1-11be-4c17-9fbc-17f9f2710220.title: spatial characteristics
53df87e1-11be-4c17-9fbc-17f9f2710220.description: The factors that influence location and interaction such as distance, accessibility, agglomeration, size, shape and relative location.

aa7f7aaa-5084-4dc1-a8ba-bdb76ac10608.title: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander approaches to health
aa7f7aaa-5084-4dc1-a8ba-bdb76ac10608.description: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples’ concept of health is holistic, encompassing physical, social, emotional, mental, cultural and spiritual health and wellbeing. This holistic understanding recognises the interconnectedness of these aspects and is proactive. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples’ approaches to health are based on this holistic understanding, and incorporates connection to Country/Place, Cultural Knowledge, Customary healing Practices and involvement of the whole Community throughout the entire life-course. These approaches are typically customised to local Communities and take into consideration broad issues such as social justice principles.

865405b0-0ab0-4792-bff5-6b7d887d9ff6.title: biomedical model of health
865405b0-0ab0-4792-bff5-6b7d887d9ff6.description: A model of health that focuses on the physical or biological aspects of disease and illness. It is a medical model of care practised by doctors and health professionals and is associated with the diagnosis, cure and treatment of disease.

c7b9a133-ccd8-4afa-9486-fa7fcead70f4.title: ecological model of health
c7b9a133-ccd8-4afa-9486-fa7fcead70f4.description: Model based on evidence that no single factor can explain why some people or groups are at higher risk than others. The ecological approach focuses on both individual and social determinants of health.

967d3e76-440d-44f9-9d48-769729d59948.title: sociocultural model of health
967d3e76-440d-44f9-9d48-769729d59948.description: This model of health attempts to address the broader influences on health (social, cultural, environmental and economic factors) rather than disease and injury. The focus is on policies, education and health promotion.

bc6a1ddb-e78a-448d-a935-fce1a4580641.title: augmented
bc6a1ddb-e78a-448d-a935-fce1a4580641.description: To increase the size, extent or value of something. For example, augmented feedback for a competitor may include receiving auditory or visual stimuli from the coach or spectators that further informs their performance.

389f8e1f-e798-43e3-a8a0-22b89783f692.title: ballistic
389f8e1f-e798-43e3-a8a0-22b89783f692.description: A high-velocity musculoskeletal movement, such as a tennis serve or boxing punch, requiring reciprocal coordination of agonistic and antagonistic muscles.

81065953-1eaf-4826-8357-dda6959153b6.title: biomechanical principles
81065953-1eaf-4826-8357-dda6959153b6.description: Scientific principles of mechanical physics concerned with describing movement and understanding the forces that cause movement. Understanding biomechanics helps to minimise the risk of injury, reduce rehabilitation time, improve sports performance and promote sport mastery.

73e131c9-b8d8-4ef2-9fcd-0eb5fcdfdda8.title: biomechanics
73e131c9-b8d8-4ef2-9fcd-0eb5fcdfdda8.description: The area of study with a focus on how and why we move. By applying the fundamental principles of physics to human movement, biomechanists describe and measure movement, and study the causes of such movement. Biomechanics in sports involves a detailed analysis of sports movements in order to minimise the risk of injury and improve performance.

0eb9f18a-4055-4c24-b7ce-5c4e948d53db.title: concept
0eb9f18a-4055-4c24-b7ce-5c4e948d53db.description: Key ideas that shape practice, e.g. equity, fitness.

5e584b43-033d-444c-ba50-8d8e8b2b3e1e.title: culturally and linguistically diverse populations
5e584b43-033d-444c-ba50-8d8e8b2b3e1e.description: Australia’s population includes many people who were born overseas, have a parent born overseas or speak a variety of languages. Together, these groups of people are known as culturally and linguistically diverse populations.

ce521bc2-e4cb-4ca1-92f4-e559d369759e.title: determinants of health
ce521bc2-e4cb-4ca1-92f4-e559d369759e.description: The range of health behaviours, personal biomedical factors, environmental factors and socioeconomic factors, as identified by the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare that determine the health status of individuals and populations.

170d7ecc-1bf8-4dd7-995a-3d13dfcb6c7e.title: dimensions of health
170d7ecc-1bf8-4dd7-995a-3d13dfcb6c7e.description: There are 5 dimensions of health. These include physical, mental, emotional, spiritual and social. These dimensions are interrelated.

ca097347-64cc-431d-8e7b-8d063a39699d.title: environmental factors
ca097347-64cc-431d-8e7b-8d063a39699d.description: Factors in the built and natural environments that impact on health, e.g. geographical location, remoteness.

9f8ca99b-b24f-4a42-9064-d91a98db73f2.title: ethical
9f8ca99b-b24f-4a42-9064-d91a98db73f2.description: Relates to moral principles. Pertaining to what is right and wrong in conduct.

9b8d290c-23b4-4954-9c9c-f455e73e0a7b.title: fartlek
9b8d290c-23b4-4954-9c9c-f455e73e0a7b.description: Means ‘speed play’ in Swedish. Fartlek training includes periods of fast running intermixed with periods of slower running.

2688f1cf-cd92-4712-a183-98a46bec629f.title: health behaviours
2688f1cf-cd92-4712-a183-98a46bec629f.description: Refers to a person’s beliefs and actions regarding their health and wellbeing. For example, tobacco use, alcohol consumption, physical activity, dietary behaviour.

596d71f1-67c2-42ab-be12-b73b8abc0990.title: health lens
596d71f1-67c2-42ab-be12-b73b8abc0990.description: A health lens in relation to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) refers to application of the goals in a way that targets the health outcomes of the community. This includes creating and improving the physical and social environments, and expanding on community resources that enable people to reach their full potential.

b977b35b-9799-49f7-8a8c-0136fc74a644.title: health promotion
b977b35b-9799-49f7-8a8c-0136fc74a644.description: The process of enabling people to increase control over, and to improve, their health.

07f626e2-2d25-42da-a735-09e30396062d.title: health status
07f626e2-2d25-42da-a735-09e30396062d.description: The health of an individual or population measured against an identifiable standard.

ec8adab1-bd8e-4dd2-ae06-c3d64db54f96.title: High Intensity Interval Training (HIIT)
ec8adab1-bd8e-4dd2-ae06-c3d64db54f96.description: Training that involves repeated bouts of high-intensity exercise followed by varying periods of complete rest or recovery at lower intensity.

b244d914-618e-47e6-af94-d6e599ae7557.title: infant mortality
b244d914-618e-47e6-af94-d6e599ae7557.description: The number of deaths among children aged under one in a given period, per 1,000 live births in the same period.

fffdb5e8-eaee-4b6e-a045-1ce3e9bfda0f.title: interplay
fffdb5e8-eaee-4b6e-a045-1ce3e9bfda0f.description: The way in which 2 or more things have an effect on each other.

35eb274d-caa6-4e57-981c-a20c5db1174f.title: Medicare
35eb274d-caa6-4e57-981c-a20c5db1174f.description: A national, government-funded scheme that subsidises the cost of personal medical services for all Australians and aims to help them afford medical care.

2b032a5b-fab0-41b5-b077-1652b056eb7b.title: micronutrients
2b032a5b-fab0-41b5-b077-1652b056eb7b.description: One of the major groups of nutrients needed by the body for energy production, immune function, blood clotting, growth, bone health and fluid balance, among other functions. Also known as vitamins and minerals.

ef087154-22fd-4e4c-a731-884f4d729dd3.title: older people
ef087154-22fd-4e4c-a731-884f4d729dd3.description: In Australia, this includes people aged 65 and over.

61b5baac-328f-41cd-b7be-b82b727fff25.title: plyometric(s)
61b5baac-328f-41cd-b7be-b82b727fff25.description: Exercises in which muscles exert maximum force in short intervals of time, with the goal of increasing power. Plyometric training may involve jumps, hops, bounds and skips.

7a3cf08a-ddb4-4f77-80fa-0c6fc2e7f572.title: Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation (PNF)
7a3cf08a-ddb4-4f77-80fa-0c6fc2e7f572.description: A form of flexibility training. It involves a phase of pushing away from the direction of stretch against resistance. This is followed by a period of relaxation with gentle reversing of the resistance to push along the line of stretch, increasing the stretch beyond its normal range.

686d2757-082d-4cf9-8606-4f9a791ac591.title: salutogenic model of health
686d2757-082d-4cf9-8606-4f9a791ac591.description: An approach to human health that examines the factors contributing to the promotion and maintenance of physical and mental wellbeing rather than disease, with particular emphasis on the coping mechanisms of individuals that help preserve health despite stressful conditions.

d25b3112-534e-4388-9435-26f6ed08059b.title: self-efficacy
d25b3112-534e-4388-9435-26f6ed08059b.description: Belief in one’s own ability to manage behaviour, emotions and motivations.

bdf6b6a3-08c0-45f4-b5d5-800ad9da2251.title: sociological causes
bdf6b6a3-08c0-45f4-b5d5-800ad9da2251.description: Societal influences or reasons. These include social relationships, social interaction and culture of everyday life.

8b3fd599-efa2-4b1e-add5-44dbcfc4ef6d.title: sport
8b3fd599-efa2-4b1e-add5-44dbcfc4ef6d.description: The term sport is broadened to include physical activity as well as organised and high-performance sport, reflecting ever-increasing opportunities for Australians to engage in physical activity throughout life.

497bc024-ebab-44a8-814d-09c431c53ce3.title: Sprint Interval Training (SIT)
497bc024-ebab-44a8-814d-09c431c53ce3.description: A form of high-intensity training characterised by repeated, brief intermittent bursts of supramaximal intensity exercise, interspersed by periods of active or passive recovery.

eecbeb0f-e12a-4f09-85f6-95789d665b57.title: advocate
eecbeb0f-e12a-4f09-85f6-95789d665b57.description: The process of arguing in support of a cause or position, or acting on behalf of yourself or another individual, to ensure that your or others’ best interests are taken into account.

c71a43c0-febd-4bd2-8125-20d69099cf84.title: aerobic
c71a43c0-febd-4bd2-8125-20d69099cf84.description: When referring to exercise, aerobic refers to any physical activity typically performed at a moderate level of intensity for extended periods of time, requiring oxygen to generate energy.

a78c959e-5c9d-40a7-a7b9-995377d37863.title: anaerobic
a78c959e-5c9d-40a7-a7b9-995377d37863.description: When referring to exercise, anaerobic refers to any physical activity that is performed at a high intensity for a short duration. A limited supply of stored glycogen is used as energy, not requiring oxygen.

d6d0f207-b4d7-46af-bd88-63e5a8a5c434.title: community
d6d0f207-b4d7-46af-bd88-63e5a8a5c434.description: A group of people linked by a common social structure and sense of belonging. This may be based on location, education, gender, interests, cultural background, political or religious beliefs. It may also refer to an online community.

74d473f2-c3bd-48e9-9f9b-33d2ef1b90d2.title: digital health
74d473f2-c3bd-48e9-9f9b-33d2ef1b90d2.description: The electronic management of health information. This includes using technology to collect and share a person’s health information, e.g. a person wearing a device to record how much exercise they do each day, or healthcare providers sharing clinical notes about an individual.

eac1ac87-1236-453c-b9d2-24fdf3b553a9.title: epidemiology
eac1ac87-1236-453c-b9d2-24fdf3b553a9.description: The study of the distribution and determinants of health-related states or events (including disease), and the application of this study to the control of diseases and other health problems.

8b49dcd3-446c-41df-982a-90c0451b27f0.title: equity
8b49dcd3-446c-41df-982a-90c0451b27f0.description: Resources are allocated in accordance with the needs of individuals and populations with the desired goal of equality of health outcomes.

dee6d4d2-5796-4cdf-812a-56e85d53d3b9.title: first aid
dee6d4d2-5796-4cdf-812a-56e85d53d3b9.description: The initial care of the ill or injured, usually given by someone who is on the scene when a person becomes ill or injured.

e8f740de-2b02-40b9-aeca-dcd68ce834fd.title: fitness
e8f740de-2b02-40b9-aeca-dcd68ce834fd.description: A measure of the body’s ability to function efficiently, effectively and without injury in everyday activities, to pursue recreational activities and to cope with emergency situations.

796ce345-f2f8-479e-a73e-09fd55c23afd.title: FITT principle
796ce345-f2f8-479e-a73e-09fd55c23afd.description: A framework for developing fitness programs that emphasises the variables – Frequency, Intensity, Type of exercise and Time or duration of exercise.

e0dd674c-daf1-4857-bd71-ca972396658f.title: fluid mechanics
e0dd674c-daf1-4857-bd71-ca972396658f.description: The study of forces and flow within fluids.

6fcd5e4e-6355-4792-a298-4f806e55ca66.title: health literacy
6fcd5e4e-6355-4792-a298-4f806e55ca66.description: The ability to selectively access and critically analyse information, navigate community services and resources, and take action to promote personal health and the health of others.

6f326c72-8c62-4596-a56d-2b9677a5c0ba.title: interrelationship
6f326c72-8c62-4596-a56d-2b9677a5c0ba.description: The way in which 2 or more things or people are connected and affect one another.

d4c8c8cc-8e55-40eb-9af5-3e5b08ce5910.title: life expectancy
d4c8c8cc-8e55-40eb-9af5-3e5b08ce5910.description: Measures how long, on average, a person is expected to live, based on current age and sex-specific death rates. It is often expressed as the number of years a person born today is expected to live.

97f7904b-d01d-4452-943d-131626ee545e.title: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
97f7904b-d01d-4452-943d-131626ee545e.description: An international organisation that develops policies for a range of social, economic and environmental challenges.

5079cc8d-f550-4c3c-b840-bfe354330c8c.title: physical fitness
5079cc8d-f550-4c3c-b840-bfe354330c8c.description: A set of attributes (health and skill components) that enable an individual to be physically active.

72e7f46b-d5c3-45ac-9fd9-e2bbcd13b7df.title: privacy
72e7f46b-d5c3-45ac-9fd9-e2bbcd13b7df.description: The right to be left alone, be free from interference or intrusion, and to have some control over your personal information and how it is accessed, used and shared.

6ec94989-7cf6-4611-a248-0184dede3796.title: stability
6ec94989-7cf6-4611-a248-0184dede3796.description: Stability skills can be categorised as static skills and dynamic skills. Static stability refers to an object at rest, whereas dynamic stability refers to an object in motion.

8823c61d-0aee-462f-be07-087556b65875.title: strategies
8823c61d-0aee-462f-be07-087556b65875.description: A plan of action developed before beginning a task or activity to successfully achieve a goal or outcome.

66d180a8-ba64-4307-8318-d8a3df3eab05.title: Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
66d180a8-ba64-4307-8318-d8a3df3eab05.description: A set of 17 global goals developed by the United Nations to be achieved by 2030. The goals are universally applied to all to end poverty, fight inequalities and tackle climate change. They influence strategies that build economic growth and address a range of social needs, including education, health, social protection and job opportunities, while tackling climate change and environmental protection.

4f009a73-a8c7-4369-937a-186acd5435a6.title: TOTAPS
4f009a73-a8c7-4369-937a-186acd5435a6.description: A way of assessing sports injuries in athletes and recreational players before allowing a player to return to the field. TOTAPS stands for Talk, Observe, Touch, Active movement, Passive movement and Skills test.

d5f8541b-6904-4288-b38c-9f7b5acc682a.title: World Health Organization (WHO)
d5f8541b-6904-4288-b38c-9f7b5acc682a.description: A specialised agency of the United Nations responsible for international public health. It aims to ensure there is universal health coverage, protect people from health emergencies and provide people with better health and wellbeing.

ee6b9b65-5bcd-4698-a162-612b0cc3713b.title: access
ee6b9b65-5bcd-4698-a162-612b0cc3713b.description: To gather information from a variety of sources, services and facilities.

7abb73b8-f1e0-4257-9232-90c9d97864ec.title: community health
7abb73b8-f1e0-4257-9232-90c9d97864ec.description: Focuses on work within defined communities to maintain and improve the health and wellbeing of all people in that community through collective action.

8a3669f6-f6cf-4999-bd94-eaaf4b24e490.title: drugs
8a3669f6-f6cf-4999-bd94-eaaf4b24e490.description: Any substance (excluding food, water and oxygen) that, when taken into a body, alters its function physically or psychologically.

8769e18d-b0f7-4e99-8024-d484fe7e72d5.title: personal care
8769e18d-b0f7-4e99-8024-d484fe7e72d5.description: Personal care is a broad term used to refer to supporting personal hygiene and toileting, along with dressing and maintaining personal appearance.

73b76e81-d2f0-4dd3-8e96-8af4d0adc10f.title: RICER
73b76e81-d2f0-4dd3-8e96-8af4d0adc10f.description: Acronym for Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation, Referral. It is a process that is used during the acute stage of injury, in the first 24 to 48 hours.

b59fb998-a3c1-4b12-83ed-a487126df101.title: before common era (BCE)
b59fb998-a3c1-4b12-83ed-a487126df101.description: A dating system to denote an abbreviation of ‘before common era’.

73113798-769c-4eda-bfbc-0591befc225d.title: Chartism
73113798-769c-4eda-bfbc-0591befc225d.description: A workers’ movement established in the 1830s, named after the 6 main aims in its People’s Charter and focused on the political rights of the working classes.

af8cc9ce-566b-4ba2-b77c-bc911a4b4051.title: common era (CE)
af8cc9ce-566b-4ba2-b77c-bc911a4b4051.description: A dating system used to denote an abbreviation of ‘common era’.

b6af5976-ed45-4977-b290-605c93ecc892.title: constitution
b6af5976-ed45-4977-b290-605c93ecc892.description: The fundamental rules that establish how a country is governed, typically establishing the role and powers of parliament, the executive and the judiciary.

89afdb80-93e6-4d2b-bb36-3c161abd4370.title: division of powers
89afdb80-93e6-4d2b-bb36-3c161abd4370.description: Australia has 3 levels of government: federal government, state and territory government and local government. Each level has different responsibilities as outlined in the Australian Constitution.

111970eb-8cb0-448f-bae5-f776c16c282d.title: Doctrine of Discovery
111970eb-8cb0-448f-bae5-f776c16c282d.description: Legal and philosophical concept that enabled European powers to claim lands inhabited by non-Christians. Key elements included papal bulls and terra nullius.

d25f6dee-4f26-41ff-813b-dbbccaa133f3.title: egalitarianism
d25f6dee-4f26-41ff-813b-dbbccaa133f3.description: The idea that all people are equal, sharing the same rights – political, social and civil.

e6dac38d-d078-44d3-a809-06b89b2eafeb.title: Imperialism
e6dac38d-d078-44d3-a809-06b89b2eafeb.description: Ideology affecting the organisation of societies, involving a nation expanding its authority over other territories (e.g. colonisation, use of military force, economic control or by other means).

2e80c776-064d-433f-8462-ecc04c286a68.title: International Indigenous Peoples
2e80c776-064d-433f-8462-ecc04c286a68.description: Refers collectively to the first peoples of a land in international communities.

c9c734c7-9c9f-46d3-a30b-c2f92bde6d0b.title: Magna Carta
c9c734c7-9c9f-46d3-a30b-c2f92bde6d0b.description: A historic charter signed in 1215 limiting the monarch’s power and establishing some legal rights to English people.

a59daf31-8d88-4123-a7ff-c5c74b0892db.title: separation of powers
a59daf31-8d88-4123-a7ff-c5c74b0892db.description: In the Australian Constitution the separation of powers distributes the power to govern between the Parliament, the executive and the judiciary to ensure checks and balances.

76e9cac6-d478-45fb-8214-29623aa66d8e.title: Stolen Generations
76e9cac6-d478-45fb-8214-29623aa66d8e.description: The generations of Aboriginal children forcibly removed from their families in the 20th century as a result of the policies of Australian governments.

7ac9eb9f-b677-4873-8c11-821d014350ed.title: ANZAC
7ac9eb9f-b677-4873-8c11-821d014350ed.description: Refers to the Australian and New Zealand Army Corps (ANZAC) troops who first fought at Gallipoli in Turkey from April to December 1915.

742be27d-0a0d-4261-884d-e4ef36521cd3.title: upstander behaviour
742be27d-0a0d-4261-884d-e4ef36521cd3.description: An individual and/or group standing up to take safe actions to support themselves and/or others.

6fefeac9-c4bd-4d75-ab6f-78b0cc327c8d.title: ancestral remains
6fefeac9-c4bd-4d75-ab6f-78b0cc327c8d.description: The physical remains of deceased individuals, culturally significant to descendant communities and central to reparations efforts.

80659850-c3aa-496a-b9e8-2da06df52fc1.title: commemoration
80659850-c3aa-496a-b9e8-2da06df52fc1.description: The public remembrance and honouring of significant historical figures or events.

503bea0f-69ac-4f79-a082-7150d80c7851.title: decolonisation
503bea0f-69ac-4f79-a082-7150d80c7851.description: The process of colonised peoples reclaiming autonomy over governance, land and culture by dismantling colonial structures and restoring or revitalising sovereignty.

f657f437-bfcc-405c-afde-49acd956229c.title: material culture
f657f437-bfcc-405c-afde-49acd956229c.description: Physical objects made or used by humans that provide evidence of how people lived, worked and thought in the past.

c3129ca3-124a-422c-b19e-fca440ecd8b4.title: memorialisation
c3129ca3-124a-422c-b19e-fca440ecd8b4.description: The preservation of the memory of historical figures or events.

37bc96c4-3e61-441a-8cef-9cc6b1e98dcc.title: Story sharing
37bc96c4-3e61-441a-8cef-9cc6b1e98dcc.description: The practice of handing down Stories that embody cultural Lore, values and teachings.

43991adf-6488-4b1c-8f19-92452b412124.title: aerial image
43991adf-6488-4b1c-8f19-92452b412124.description: Image taken from the air showing characteristics of an area. It may be at an oblique angle or a vertical angle.

2bddea08-397c-44f0-adee-4c14cf875c0c.title: Cultural exchange
2bddea08-397c-44f0-adee-4c14cf875c0c.description: Relating to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Communities, the exchange between the products of each other’s Culture.

07693a17-e8b1-40f4-bde3-7035130a53aa.title: geographical information
07693a17-e8b1-40f4-bde3-7035130a53aa.description: Quantitative or qualitative information about people, places and environments.

95d322ff-6e89-4f46-851f-a4a0031230d8.title: Indigenous peoples
95d322ff-6e89-4f46-851f-a4a0031230d8.description: This term is used when referring collectively to the first peoples of a land in international communities. The term Indigenous Australians is used when speaking about both Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples within Australia.

a84048a9-b2f0-4d2d-a2e6-a0baf6d3c13d.title: seasonal calendar
a84048a9-b2f0-4d2d-a2e6-a0baf6d3c13d.description: A classification of weeks or months of a year into seasons. For example, in Aboriginal Cultures classifications vary and are finely tuned to local climates and availability of food and other resources.

cd4893d5-b8d3-482f-a8fe-793271616599.title: source
cd4893d5-b8d3-482f-a8fe-793271616599.description: Any written or non-written materials that can be used to investigate the past.

49eef842-894f-45fd-abda-e371a0f65c2b.title: Welcome to Country
49eef842-894f-45fd-abda-e371a0f65c2b.description: An ongoing protocol given by a Traditional Custodian of the Country.

aa105ab3-c728-43bc-ab1f-2a171437a4ed.title: jigs
aa105ab3-c728-43bc-ab1f-2a171437a4ed.description: A custom-made tool or piece of equipment used to control the positioning and/or motion of another tool to go into a work piece.

a9fde35d-d1f5-4679-83f0-05f3047cef23.title: award
a9fde35d-d1f5-4679-83f0-05f3047cef23.description: The industry-specific terms and conditions of employment which are applied to employees.

d4ee6972-8736-481d-892d-bf5b20b658c6.title: community-based orders
d4ee6972-8736-481d-892d-bf5b20b658c6.description: A non-custodial sentence that requires supervision of the offender who is subject to conditions while living in the community.

17e18846-0cec-45ac-bd01-30a7fc0e5db4.title: enterprise agreement
17e18846-0cec-45ac-bd01-30a7fc0e5db4.description: An agreement that is legally binding and sets out the pay and working conditions between employees and employers in a specific workplace.

9834e666-b11f-407d-8c1f-1f01e7f9e1a1.title: equity
9834e666-b11f-407d-8c1f-1f01e7f9e1a1.description: A recognition of what is fair and just ensuring that adjustments are made to overcome barriers due to bias or systemic structures.

f83d005c-2fcd-4872-a11f-768e3839afca.title: plea
f83d005c-2fcd-4872-a11f-768e3839afca.description: A response to a criminal charge from the accused as either guilty or not guilty.

ebed01a8-2d19-4af7-a0a7-2705a77f2840.title: adversarial system
ebed01a8-2d19-4af7-a0a7-2705a77f2840.description: System of trial used in Australia where representatives act for opposing parties before an independent arbitrator who ensures the strict rules of evidence and procedure are maintained in the court.

3cc478e9-588c-4ad1-906c-36d30fd789d7.title: civil law
3cc478e9-588c-4ad1-906c-36d30fd789d7.description: A body of law relating to disputes between individuals such as negligence, defamation or contract law.

904df5b2-ea18-4eaa-9973-57cd55340ebb.title: contract
904df5b2-ea18-4eaa-9973-57cd55340ebb.description: An agreement between 2 or more individuals or organisations that is enforceable by law.

773b4cc6-215d-45d7-9fe4-b43312f1267c.title: crime
773b4cc6-215d-45d7-9fe4-b43312f1267c.description: An act or omission that is harmful to society, violates the law and is punishable by the state.

7a42ca0c-6064-4bb5-b6c8-ce4729f10fc8.title: diversionary
7a42ca0c-6064-4bb5-b6c8-ce4729f10fc8.description: A process of moving an individual away from offending towards rehabilitation, to address the underlying causes of their behaviour and to avoid going to court.

74a1aea0-4e4a-429d-9998-22d1d1234fb6.title: entitlement
74a1aea0-4e4a-429d-9998-22d1d1234fb6.description: The rights and benefits that employees are legally permitted to under law.

8fc64dc7-c760-4642-b2ab-236cff85b2ae.title: fairness
8fc64dc7-c760-4642-b2ab-236cff85b2ae.description: The impartial and just treatment of individuals.

1ab3ad2e-d48b-401f-b2d0-d9d4983fb930.title: human rights
1ab3ad2e-d48b-401f-b2d0-d9d4983fb930.description: Universal freedoms and protections that belong to all individuals and groups by virtue of being human.

1bc5f0a4-edfd-4d28-be1d-8a04e8711a64.title: legal measures
1bc5f0a4-edfd-4d28-be1d-8a04e8711a64.description: Any act or process in law designed to regulate behaviour, prohibit actions or establish obligations.

64610642-755b-4ce3-90ae-d698be86eba0.title: non-legal measures
64610642-755b-4ce3-90ae-d698be86eba0.description: A course of action used to address a situation without using the law.

ea6662a4-c27d-46f7-9d8c-6b4d0df1ec0e.title: referendum
ea6662a4-c27d-46f7-9d8c-6b4d0df1ec0e.description: A national vote to propose a change to the Constitution.

4a63986d-736f-4e00-88e5-aff0dccd67de.title: regulation
4a63986d-736f-4e00-88e5-aff0dccd67de.description: The control of actions or processes in a certain area, usually maintained by an authority.

d598774b-53ae-43f2-91dd-cabd9063c8ff.title: rule of law
d598774b-53ae-43f2-91dd-cabd9063c8ff.description: The principle that all citizens are equal before the law and that no one is above the law.

2439d34f-e82a-4eb8-ba57-c6d6e908ce82.title: tribunal
2439d34f-e82a-4eb8-ba57-c6d6e908ce82.description: A body established to settle disputes, review administrative decisions and handle matters in a specialised area.

a084c40e-47f2-41bc-9569-3b35e44d2e64.title: actus reus
a084c40e-47f2-41bc-9569-3b35e44d2e64.description:
Latin for ’the guilty act’. One of the 2 elements of a crime.

See mens rea

5d22d6e9-af7b-4dc3-bf07-445df99e01a2.title: ad hoc tribunal
5d22d6e9-af7b-4dc3-bf07-445df99e01a2.description: The temporary formation of a body or board of inquiry to investigate and rule on a particular event or fulfil a particular purpose.

3e5afea2-07ac-4360-940f-b64cff423418.title: anti-competitive
3e5afea2-07ac-4360-940f-b64cff423418.description: Any business practice that limits or prevents competition.

11eb1852-a82e-4761-9442-39d04e68b681.title: authorities
11eb1852-a82e-4761-9442-39d04e68b681.description: Organisations that have the power to determine, adjudicate or settle issues or disputes in a specialised area or subject.

a4210dad-bc83-4948-9aaf-e554ef03491c.title: burden of proof
a4210dad-bc83-4948-9aaf-e554ef03491c.description: The responsibility of proving the case against the accused in a criminal matter or the defendant in a civil matter.

4a876132-1b19-43fc-9d5d-9b82cd826cbe.title: causation
4a876132-1b19-43fc-9d5d-9b82cd826cbe.description: The link between a person accused of a crime and the end result. The actions that led to the crime.

f7bbaaaf-cc6a-4384-9478-177481fae86c.title: collective security
f7bbaaaf-cc6a-4384-9478-177481fae86c.description: A system of security where nation-states agree to commit to a united response against any threat or breach of peace.

0239053e-485c-467f-a421-c8f9620ca647.title: compliance
0239053e-485c-467f-a421-c8f9620ca647.description: Following the rules and laws in society.

26fadd55-8368-408b-a4e8-94ed4e7302df.title: custodial penalties
26fadd55-8368-408b-a4e8-94ed4e7302df.description: A penalty ordered by the court where an offender is confined to a prison or other correctional facility for a set period of time.

1a394df0-a874-4b94-a32f-651bd0a66bd3.title: de facto
1a394df0-a874-4b94-a32f-651bd0a66bd3.description: Two people living together in a genuine domestic relationship but who are not legally married.

ba0aff1e-7949-4ceb-85f6-12cf27786102.title: delegated legislation
ba0aff1e-7949-4ceb-85f6-12cf27786102.description: Laws created by bodies other than parliament who derive their authority from an Act of parliament.

21dda730-0afc-464f-949c-48d465967fed.title: diplomacy
21dda730-0afc-464f-949c-48d465967fed.description: The actions of maintaining relationships through discussions, negotiation and mediation between nations, groups or individuals to promote peace and prevent conflict.

22c8d8bd-e55e-4522-9d51-d01e92e75293.title: discretion
22c8d8bd-e55e-4522-9d51-d01e92e75293.description: The power of a judge or police officer to act or make a decision based on personal experience or judgement.

62fe4ff8-267e-4013-8f4d-a28a8e29d6ae.title: displacement
62fe4ff8-267e-4013-8f4d-a28a8e29d6ae.description: The forced movement of people from their homes either within a country’s borders or across borders due to armed conflict, violence or insecurity.

fee47b60-c6bc-43bf-ac82-04df0c1b75af.title: equality
fee47b60-c6bc-43bf-ac82-04df0c1b75af.description: To be equal, having the same rights or standing in society.

83689661-a82f-4e4a-aadf-781c2931b13e.title: evolving capacity
83689661-a82f-4e4a-aadf-781c2931b13e.description: The increasing ability for children and young people to make reasoned decisions for themselves as they grow and develop.

876ac469-f89e-4ce8-a918-8edf1e1b37c1.title: exploitation
876ac469-f89e-4ce8-a918-8edf1e1b37c1.description: The act of using or treating someone unfairly for profit or gain.

67678552-ad36-4481-8ea6-8619de3a027a.title: indictable crime
67678552-ad36-4481-8ea6-8619de3a027a.description: A serious criminal charge heard before a judge and jury.

d07306ec-ddf2-41e3-a1c8-9a7484c745b3.title: intergovernmental organisation
d07306ec-ddf2-41e3-a1c8-9a7484c745b3.description: An international body established by treaty or agreement amongst nations to address common interests and goals.

10e2e61e-987b-4c4a-acce-c84633e13879.title: international relations
10e2e61e-987b-4c4a-acce-c84633e13879.description: When relationships exist between 2 or more countries with the prospect to cooperate through diplomacy, foreign policy and international law.

3a6f688e-4686-4bc1-be00-3aaa2967d9ea.title: judicial
3a6f688e-4686-4bc1-be00-3aaa2967d9ea.description: An action made by a judge or court.

e789649a-58e6-4291-a895-3664b2773ff7.title: jurisdiction
e789649a-58e6-4291-a895-3664b2773ff7.description: The area or matter in which a court or parliament has authority.

cf8550de-0c89-4805-a34b-7e149850a15d.title: justice reinvestment
cf8550de-0c89-4805-a34b-7e149850a15d.description: A strategy to redirect funding from prisons towards community-based programs to address the underlying causes of crime.

26c22a3c-be85-494c-ad69-302010c02ce3.title: loss
26c22a3c-be85-494c-ad69-302010c02ce3.description: One of the elements of civil law. The harm, injury or damages suffered by the plaintiff due to someone’s actions, which can include physical injury, property damage or financial loss.

6e17afb6-e4d5-464b-8fb4-725af094726b.title: mens rea
6e17afb6-e4d5-464b-8fb4-725af094726b.description:
Latin for ‘the guilty mind’. One of the 2 elements of a crime.

See actus reus

7c3e92d0-a74e-4f21-9082-5ca3f0f8af80.title: non-compliance
7c3e92d0-a74e-4f21-9082-5ca3f0f8af80.description: Failure to follow the rules or act within the law.

0e643b0f-6184-48df-8663-b42945d1bdfb.title: non-state actors
0e643b0f-6184-48df-8663-b42945d1bdfb.description: An organisation or entity that has influence in the global sphere but is independent and not affiliated with any nation-state or government.

ffa39e1f-7c61-40a0-9330-68112bb444cd.title: obligation
ffa39e1f-7c61-40a0-9330-68112bb444cd.description: A duty or responsibility that is binding on individuals, businesses or nation-states, and enforceable by law.

a3d840b1-b10c-44e0-84f9-963465a0e47f.title: peacebuilding
a3d840b1-b10c-44e0-84f9-963465a0e47f.description: Assistance provided over the long term to countries impacted by conflict that addresses its root cause and which develops ways to prevent violence in the future.

07f7cf7d-171f-453f-8613-c6fa2bfff4d7.title: peacekeeping
07f7cf7d-171f-453f-8613-c6fa2bfff4d7.description: Actions undertaken by armed forces with the consent of all parties, to restore peace and security in areas impacted by conflict.

818961d9-3711-4048-92f7-34d8cd956f50.title: pre-trial processes
818961d9-3711-4048-92f7-34d8cd956f50.description: Steps taken before a trial to determine if the case is ready. This could include charges to be put forward, the entering of a plea or the disclosure of evidence.

3ec36f02-214c-4611-960b-3a64ee073765.title: precedent
3ec36f02-214c-4611-960b-3a64ee073765.description: A legal decision made in a higher court that may be followed by that court or a lower court in a case with similar facts.

db2d45d6-1e4e-4471-9242-3a790c3f4381.title: procedural fairness
db2d45d6-1e4e-4471-9242-3a790c3f4381.description: The steps taken by a decision-maker to ensure a fair and impartial process.

862d0744-1e81-4bfa-982a-c0e5ea181b11.title: recidivism
862d0744-1e81-4bfa-982a-c0e5ea181b11.description: Repeat offending by an individual convicted and punished for a crime.

c7e9fb3a-0e64-45ef-bf55-99088a930aa0.title: recognition
c7e9fb3a-0e64-45ef-bf55-99088a930aa0.description: The formal acceptance of a claim, authority, achievement or fact as valid and existing.

5a2b3960-5f87-4be6-9c51-125208ffa17c.title: reform
5a2b3960-5f87-4be6-9c51-125208ffa17c.description: Changes made to the legal system to address outdated laws or reflect changing social values.

d151c76c-2f06-4935-8406-2038586af514.title: sanctions
d151c76c-2f06-4935-8406-2038586af514.description: A measure used in international law to deter behaviour or restore peace and security.

8feab032-82d5-4bf2-985c-54703712538f.title: standard of proof
8feab032-82d5-4bf2-985c-54703712538f.description: The level of certainty required for a court to find evidence to be a proven fact.

6e8a060d-be91-453b-bed0-308e45dc87ec.title: state sovereignty
6e8a060d-be91-453b-bed0-308e45dc87ec.description: A state’s authority to govern itself and its people without foreign interference.

fb01f4e2-913b-46a1-925a-d0f1d8ac140a.title: strict liability
fb01f4e2-913b-46a1-925a-d0f1d8ac140a.description: Actions where the law must only prove the person is responsible for the act, even without the intent to commit a crime.

4cf25b7d-8282-4e19-a4a7-db111a2c448c.title: summary crime
4cf25b7d-8282-4e19-a4a7-db111a2c448c.description: A minor criminal charge heard in a local court before a magistrate.

457deaff-ff5b-42d0-a714-0511289e6470.title: radian
457deaff-ff5b-42d0-a714-0511289e6470.description:
A unit of angular measure frequently used in mathematics.

1 radian is the angle between 2 radii of a circle which cut off on the circumference an arc equal to the radius.

54ad8f30-e5c4-4579-87a9-edbec21c65a0.title: random variable
54ad8f30-e5c4-4579-87a9-edbec21c65a0.description: A variable whose possible values are outcomes of a statistical experiment or a random phenomenon.

b393e14c-b637-4caa-b166-37904e1d133d.title: array
b393e14c-b637-4caa-b166-37904e1d133d.description: One of several different arrangements that can be used to model multiplicative situations. It is made by arranging a set of objects, such as counters, into columns and rows. Each column must contain the same number of objects as the other columns, and each row must contain the same number of objects as the other rows.

8ca22f17-a6fb-4f36-9b06-b1861efa0d7a.title: circle
8ca22f17-a6fb-4f36-9b06-b1861efa0d7a.description: All points equal to a given distance from a fixed point, the centre. When used to describe a shape, a circle includes all points inside the boundary.

9af3b05f-b543-4f1a-b627-5e52b34013a9.title: equivalent
9af3b05f-b543-4f1a-b627-5e52b34013a9.description:
Two things are equivalent if they have the same value.

See equal, equals sign

772dc9c4-d1a2-4648-970d-1d62f332be19.title: algebraic fraction
772dc9c4-d1a2-4648-970d-1d62f332be19.description: A fraction in which the numerator and/or the denominator are algebraic expressions.

85969df4-3872-4b15-98dc-f90d8216804e.title: angle
85969df4-3872-4b15-98dc-f90d8216804e.description: Formed by 2 straight lines meeting at a common endpoint, called the vertex. An angle can describe the amount of turn between its 2 arms (lines).

f7e54bab-45a0-4287-9072-9054fa44a9c4.title: angle of depression
f7e54bab-45a0-4287-9072-9054fa44a9c4.description: The angle between horizontal and the line of sight from an observer to an object that is lower than the observer.

dac80f24-e86d-4d51-a137-40f5dfd95488.title: angle of elevation
dac80f24-e86d-4d51-a137-40f5dfd95488.description: The angle between horizontal and the line of sight from an observer to an object that is higher than the observer.

28a2ba81-5f82-48b5-9a0d-ce8b2c812459.title: arc
28a2ba81-5f82-48b5-9a0d-ce8b2c812459.description:
A part of a circle’s circumference.

Extended in Mathematics Extension 1: A part of a curve.

10d2261e-a745-4855-9fa3-6c08030690c5.title: average
10d2261e-a745-4855-9fa3-6c08030690c5.description: A number expressing a central or typical value in a set of data. While it usually refers to the arithmetic mean, that is, the sum of a set of numbers divided by the number of numbers in the set, it may also refer to other measures of centre.

019f29c4-7948-4614-ba99-267b5e395b5c.title: bearing
019f29c4-7948-4614-ba99-267b5e395b5c.description:
A direction from one point on the Earth’s surface to another. Two types of bearings may be used: compass bearing and true bearing.

See compass bearing and true bearing

f04e4073-64b5-4e38-8cd7-7ebf6c70208a.title: compass bearing
f04e4073-64b5-4e38-8cd7-7ebf6c70208a.description: Angles either side of north or south. For example, a compass bearing of N50°E is found by facing north and moving through an angle of 50° to the east.

a40b3d7f-7ef1-4294-9a21-f7d484aa7b38.title: compound interest
a40b3d7f-7ef1-4294-9a21-f7d484aa7b38.description: The interest earned by investing a sum of money (the principal) when each successive interest payment is added to the principal for calculating the next interest payment.

6348af2b-a76e-40b3-a4cc-c57346f514c1.title: degree (networks)
6348af2b-a76e-40b3-a4cc-c57346f514c1.description: The degree of a vertex is the number of edge ends at that vertex.

c48f008c-dbf9-425f-8284-b10c323f5898.title: dependent variable
c48f008c-dbf9-425f-8284-b10c323f5898.description: The variable used to represent the output values of a function. A dependent variable is generally represented on the vertical axis of a graph.

9ed4fee5-bb1f-49e6-875d-bf90097fc4ec.title: direct variation
9ed4fee5-bb1f-49e6-875d-bf90097fc4ec.description: A proportional relationship where one quantity directly varies with respect to a change in another quantity. This implies that if there is an increase (or decrease) in one quantity then the other quantity will experience a proportionate increase (or decrease).

553d0562-fe47-4ae7-a19d-591ade7af27f.title: discrete variable
553d0562-fe47-4ae7-a19d-591ade7af27f.description:
Individual and countable items that can be listed.

Extended in Mathematics Advanced: Also known as a discrete random variable.

60d6a07e-e494-4f32-b1aa-ecfc20c45710.title: enlargement
60d6a07e-e494-4f32-b1aa-ecfc20c45710.description: A type of transformation that increases or decreases the size of an image without changing its shape, depending on the size of the enlargement factor.

dd828fd7-eff9-4d6a-8eb7-cdaad62f4295.title: frequency
dd828fd7-eff9-4d6a-8eb7-cdaad62f4295.description: The number of times that a particular value occurs in a dataset. For grouped data, it is the number of observations that lie in that group or class interval. For example, when rolling a dice 20 times, ‘the frequency of a 6’ means how many times the number 6 comes up.

d6aa0b99-a425-419b-8aa8-8879d5891835.title: future value
d6aa0b99-a425-419b-8aa8-8879d5891835.description: The total value of an investment or annuity at the end of a specified term, including all contributions and interest earned.

58a1ba0a-d3fd-4a24-aa9b-777d98efebb8.title: independent events
58a1ba0a-d3fd-4a24-aa9b-777d98efebb8.description: Two events are independent if knowing the outcome of one event tells us nothing about the outcome of the other event.

46fbe9fb-49f4-438f-bb24-70b6077f006c.title: independent variable
46fbe9fb-49f4-438f-bb24-70b6077f006c.description: A variable used to represent values in the domain (input values) of a function. Generally represented on the horizontal axis of a graph.

5cf3c315-1ce0-42ed-aa0e-443a39a7e6b6.title: index
5cf3c315-1ce0-42ed-aa0e-443a39a7e6b6.description: Also called ‘exponent’. The power to which a number or algebraic expression is to be raised. The index or exponent is written as a superscript. Positive integral exponents indicate the number of times a term is to be multiplied by itself.

8374099c-5935-4477-9207-53ffeb8f856b.title: integer
8374099c-5935-4477-9207-53ffeb8f856b.description:
A whole number, positive, negative or zero, e.g. −3, −2, −1, 0, 1, 2 …

Extended in Advanced, Extension 1, Extension 2: The set of integers is usually denoted by ℤ.

04cd21c4-c6fd-49ba-9f90-85d1bffc7c62.title: logarithmic scale
04cd21c4-c6fd-49ba-9f90-85d1bffc7c62.description: A scale where successive endpoint values of intervals increase by a constant factor (multiplicatively). Contrast with linear scales in which the increase is a constant amount.

1e4d9f64-a270-4a92-baad-561bd3006890.title: measure of centre
1e4d9f64-a270-4a92-baad-561bd3006890.description: A statistic that is used to summarise a dataset. There are 3 common measures of centre for a dataset: mode, median and mean.

65878b80-2639-4bf6-913c-d6dc0cfe2c5c.title: median
65878b80-2639-4bf6-913c-d6dc0cfe2c5c.description:
The value in a set of ordered data that divides the data into 2 parts. It is frequently called the 'middle value'.

Extended in Mathematics Standard and Advanced: If the number of values in the ordered dataset is even, it is the average of the two middle values. If the number of values in the dataset is odd, the median is the middle value.

ce477d5b-a46b-42d2-9b3b-fbc1af8aa021.title: mode
ce477d5b-a46b-42d2-9b3b-fbc1af8aa021.description:
The most frequently occurring value in a set of data.

Extended in 7–10: There can be more than one mode. When there are 2 modes, the dataset is said to be bimodal.

974ef39d-bb4e-4b7b-8d36-fdc38072dfa4.title: mutually exclusive events
974ef39d-bb4e-4b7b-8d36-fdc38072dfa4.description:
Two events that cannot have simultaneous outcomes in the same chance experiment. For example, when a fair coin is tossed twice, the events 'HH' and 'TT' cannot occur at the same time and are, therefore, mutually exclusive.

In a Venn diagram, as shown below, mutually exclusive events do not overlap.

362b235f-a95d-4955-b5bb-fb7363dd36b8.title: perpendicular
362b235f-a95d-4955-b5bb-fb7363dd36b8.description: Two lines, rays, line segments, vectors, planes or other objects that intersect at a 90° angle (a right angle).

e61934cb-0760-4239-a7b6-37de7006fff4.title: probability
e61934cb-0760-4239-a7b6-37de7006fff4.description: The chance of something happening shown on a scale from 0 and 1 (inclusive). For example, the probability that a fair coin toss will come up ‘heads’ is 0.5.

70bfbbbd-e46d-4c08-8669-cd6edd0ef61b.title: proof
70bfbbbd-e46d-4c08-8669-cd6edd0ef61b.description: A rigorous mathematical argument that demonstrates the truth of a given statement or proposition. A mathematical statement that has been established by means of a proof is called a theorem.

277f8cfd-c16b-4d18-bde9-aec317ae6cde.title: range (function)
277f8cfd-c16b-4d18-bde9-aec317ae6cde.description: The set of values of the dependent variable for which a function is defined.

5a5cdf27-4ac5-4c4b-9c91-91d76952f472.title: sample
5a5cdf27-4ac5-4c4b-9c91-91d76952f472.description: A subset of a population used to estimate characteristics of the population. For example, a randomly selected group of 8-year-olds (sample) selected to estimate the height of 8-year-olds in Australia (population).

cd45c306-7eda-43fb-9b41-bf5806bcc0b8.title: secant
cd45c306-7eda-43fb-9b41-bf5806bcc0b8.description: The straight line passing through 2 points on the graph of a function.

ded7ae8c-71b7-4a73-9706-c96118621572.title: sector
ded7ae8c-71b7-4a73-9706-c96118621572.description: The plane figure enclosed by 2 radii or a circle and the arc between them.

e5fb186a-eac4-4a53-a58b-06d463093464.title: segment
e5fb186a-eac4-4a53-a58b-06d463093464.description: A plane figure enclosed by a chord and the arc joining the endpoints of a chord.

7ed18422-f679-42fe-a53c-6e5450641ca7.title: subtend
7ed18422-f679-42fe-a53c-6e5450641ca7.description: In geometry, an angle subtended by an arc or interval is the angle whose 2 rays pass through the endpoints of the arc or interval. A possible synonym for ‘subtends’ is ‘makes’.

7bb80903-2468-4e0b-9000-5eecdb6318f5.title: tangent
7bb80903-2468-4e0b-9000-5eecdb6318f5.description: A line that intersects a circle at just one point. It touches the circle at that point of contact but does not pass inside it.

75a083df-12c8-4507-b88d-bb16d16310de.title: tree diagram
75a083df-12c8-4507-b88d-bb16d16310de.description:
A diagram consisting of line segments (edges) connected to points (vertices) like the branches of a tree. It shows the relationship between sets, events or the set of outcomes of a multi-step random experiment.

See probability tree

d9854ef5-233a-4284-8af2-c4c168c776d9.title: trigonometric ratios
d9854ef5-233a-4284-8af2-c4c168c776d9.description:
The relationship between the angles and sides of right-angled triangles. The 3 basic trigonometric ratios are sine, cosine and tangent.

See sine ratio, cosine ratio and tangent ratio

ff392011-7612-411d-8bae-38ff22185a9c.title: two-way table
ff392011-7612-411d-8bae-38ff22185a9c.description: A common way of displaying the two-way frequency distribution that arises when a group is categorised according to 2 criteria.

3b35d279-7eff-40c7-ac95-fd164fe77f5d.title: variable (statistics)
3b35d279-7eff-40c7-ac95-fd164fe77f5d.description: Something measurable or observable that is expected to change either over time or between individual observations. For example, the age of students, their hair colour or a playing field's length or its shape.

cda0efed-9b32-4249-a60f-4b11310cb356.title: Venn diagram
cda0efed-9b32-4249-a60f-4b11310cb356.description: Graphical representations, using several typically overlapping circles, showing elements of sets in relation to properties or attributes. They are drawn for some specified universal set.

efec3e1e-01dc-4e2f-bba7-d47fa7450821.title: vertical line test
efec3e1e-01dc-4e2f-bba7-d47fa7450821.description: Determines whether a relation or graph is also a function. If a vertical line intersects or touches a graph at more than one point, then the graph is not a function.

36387118-2792-4836-b420-55166cd22f0d.title: arithmetic progression (AP)
36387118-2792-4836-b420-55166cd22f0d.description: A sequence of numbers in which the difference between any 2 successive terms of the sequence is constant. Also known as arithmetic sequence.

f801ca26-37ad-4562-a3ed-e66a55a83637.title: common difference
f801ca26-37ad-4562-a3ed-e66a55a83637.description: The constant difference between successive terms of an arithmetic sequence.

07e2dc1a-6cd0-46f4-8833-3a3949aff4a2.title: common ratio
07e2dc1a-6cd0-46f4-8833-3a3949aff4a2.description: The constant ratio between successive terms of a geometric sequence.

ffedcb7f-69ba-4778-b188-76252c45bdea.title: concave down
ffedcb7f-69ba-4778-b188-76252c45bdea.description: A function in which all points on a graph between any 2 given points on the graph lie on or above the chord joining the given points.

0adf941e-8fd3-48f3-a0da-cccd6543db6b.title: concave up
0adf941e-8fd3-48f3-a0da-cccd6543db6b.description: A function for which all points on a graph between any 2 given points on the graph lie on or below the chord joining the given points.

d4d42dfc-6db8-4bdc-b9b1-d3e4959236c9.title: constant function
d4d42dfc-6db8-4bdc-b9b1-d3e4959236c9.description: A function that has only one value.

643ec7ab-2db3-4920-954d-601f67f24463.title: continuous function
643ec7ab-2db3-4920-954d-601f67f24463.description: The graph of a continuous function is an unbroken curve. It can be drawn without lifting the pen off the paper.

3634e197-0c57-43ff-89ba-5c5df64781d1.title: continuous random variable
3634e197-0c57-43ff-89ba-5c5df64781d1.description: A continuous random variable is a numerical variable that can take any value along a continuum.

0b9c9403-b4ba-450d-ba17-f3c8c133e36d.title: cosecant ratio

041c7f00-ecc5-487a-b00f-266a98243831.title: cotangent ratio

6ae6647e-32d5-4eed-9d11-dba845ff12d7.title: differentiation
6ae6647e-32d5-4eed-9d11-dba845ff12d7.description: The process used to find the derivative of a function.

f5dd650a-073e-4b63-bc38-52f566198bb7.title: discontinuity
f5dd650a-073e-4b63-bc38-52f566198bb7.description: A point at which the graph of a function is broken (not continuous) and the function is undefined.

3113f381-5c07-439b-9ac7-064036e366d7.title: discrete random variable
3113f381-5c07-439b-9ac7-064036e366d7.description: A numerical variable whose values can be listed.

022b14b9-7964-4e66-9478-67519e80e63a.title: disjoint (sets)
022b14b9-7964-4e66-9478-67519e80e63a.description: Two sets that do not have any common elements.

e81183a0-4759-41f9-aa0a-13cb5664a33b.title: empty set
e81183a0-4759-41f9-aa0a-13cb5664a33b.description: The unique set characterised by the property that it has no elements at all.

3360dfa2-0541-4b23-8c24-e40ea0d528e6.title: exponential decay
3360dfa2-0541-4b23-8c24-e40ea0d528e6.description: Occurs when the rate of change of a mathematical function is negative and proportional to the function’s current value.

70c40d2f-2062-4041-86c4-3dfef1fcfa74.title: exponential growth
70c40d2f-2062-4041-86c4-3dfef1fcfa74.description: Occurs when the rate of change of a mathematical function is positive and proportional to the function’s current value.

e7a374dc-71d0-4248-ada7-5d3fcaa867ef.title: geometric sequence
e7a374dc-71d0-4248-ada7-5d3fcaa867ef.description: A sequence of numbers where each term after the first is found by multiplying the previous term by a fixed number called the common ratio. Sometimes called a geometric progression (GP).

5671bd99-b784-4e00-944d-c90f99e6238d.title: geometric series
5671bd99-b784-4e00-944d-c90f99e6238d.description: A geometric series is a sum whose terms form a geometric sequence.

173fe421-f7a8-4a9d-b6ce-7c44a2e6ccc9.title: global maximum
173fe421-f7a8-4a9d-b6ce-7c44a2e6ccc9.description: The largest value of the function on its domain.

cd952243-c7d3-4984-98d6-26ea049ac403.title: global minimum
cd952243-c7d3-4984-98d6-26ea049ac403.description: The smallest value of the function on its domain.

f7eb3b74-5c8e-4c03-85e3-a88d739db423.title: instantaneous rate of change
f7eb3b74-5c8e-4c03-85e3-a88d739db423.description: The rate of change at a particular moment. For a differentiable function, the instantaneous rate of change at a point is its derivative at that point, so it equals the gradient of the tangent to its graph at the point.

9c99b99d-ec9d-45d0-80ce-e212f182f0b1.title: local maximum
9c99b99d-ec9d-45d0-80ce-e212f182f0b1.description: A point on a function is a local maximum if its function value is larger than the function values near it.

149c263d-b0b3-4be0-870e-62f00762ddc5.title: local minimum
149c263d-b0b3-4be0-870e-62f00762ddc5.description: A point on a function is a local minimum if its function value is smaller than the function values near it.

eb14117b-9e73-4d94-a62a-3e37c15d7304.title: normal random variable
eb14117b-9e73-4d94-a62a-3e37c15d7304.description: A variable that varies according to the normal distribution.

1127e54a-8d34-473b-9514-8e7d96704e17.title: reduction
1127e54a-8d34-473b-9514-8e7d96704e17.description: A type of transformation that decreases the size of an image by a factor without changing its shape.

e44f6678-4551-4e08-a4a5-7c3826e61992.title: secant (ratio)

6cb6cfa2-2351-42a6-a396-0f3c9b33b793.title: trapezoidal rule
6cb6cfa2-2351-42a6-a396-0f3c9b33b793.description: A method of approximating the area of an irregular shape, or a region bounded by a curve and an axis, by slicing the area up into trapeziums (trapezia) of equal height.

340bf0de-0387-4f31-9c99-7dc6c4670e44.title: uniform distribution
340bf0de-0387-4f31-9c99-7dc6c4670e44.description: A probability distribution in which all values of the random variable are equally likely.

f31e8cb2-f5dc-49df-9bec-2f3ef0f593ad.title: universal set
f31e8cb2-f5dc-49df-9bec-2f3ef0f593ad.description: The universal set for a particular problem or context contains all elements involved in the problem.

e808b52e-a06a-48d9-b62e-cb4261c4357c.title: arithmetic sequence
e808b52e-a06a-48d9-b62e-cb4261c4357c.description: A sequence of numbers in which the difference between any 2 successive terms of the sequence is constant. Also known as arithmetic progression.

f9230db1-db8f-44e1-b63c-c1bedbfaa47d.title: outcome
f9230db1-db8f-44e1-b63c-c1bedbfaa47d.description: Possible result from an experiment or trial.

cafcfb54-0b25-4a82-89c0-c048a0e6d23e.title: reflection
cafcfb54-0b25-4a82-89c0-c048a0e6d23e.description: A transformation of a shape formed by creating a mirror image on the other side of a given line.

e390c4b2-df1d-4920-922c-e88e7059ac65.title: acceleration
e390c4b2-df1d-4920-922c-e88e7059ac65.description: The rate at which velocity changes over time.

6698ffb6-cd1f-4b3f-9f91-845a9e2e2c82.title: annuity
6698ffb6-cd1f-4b3f-9f91-845a9e2e2c82.description: A compound interest investment to which payments are made, or a single sum invested from which payments are received, on a regular basis for a fixed period of time.

97213eb0-f3fc-4a2c-b855-d24231a6fee4.title: association
97213eb0-f3fc-4a2c-b855-d24231a6fee4.description: Relationship between pairs of numerical variables, e.g. in terms of strength, form and direction.

e93073b5-5e64-44c1-9bbe-fc9abe0be424.title: axis of symmetry
e93073b5-5e64-44c1-9bbe-fc9abe0be424.description: A straight line that divides a shape or curve into 2 so that one side is a reflection of the other in the given line.

dc2a8700-7c62-4bbb-b955-12763e9c33f4.title: break-even point
dc2a8700-7c62-4bbb-b955-12763e9c33f4.description: The point at which income from production and cost of production are equal.

084584ad-cca0-4e2b-9f63-4908c7afb91b.title: complement
084584ad-cca0-4e2b-9f63-4908c7afb91b.description: All of the outcomes that are not in a given event. All the elements of a set that are not in a given subset.

ac6cf228-7912-4135-a20a-22c1341597cd.title: contribution
